[IALC.3.3] **Newly vendored libraries.** Every vendored library that
allocates must be routed to the `DS_*` layer before it lands — by a
compile-time hook or a header edit. A library that offers neither and
calls libc directly cannot be reached by either build mode of
[IALC.1.2], and is a documented coverage gap rather than a silent one.
